historical_commentary.text: 4D Mobile (and its bundled Wakanda web server) has been fully discontinued, so this session-management workflow no longer applies; the underlying WEB session commands referenced still exist for 4D's own web server, but the 4D Mobile-specific behaviors and the Wakanda administration console use case described here are defunct.
